description.en: OpenCode's free-tier models on opencode.ai/inference. Requests are sent with exactly the headers OpenCode 1.19.0 sends (the free tier 403s anything else), with live model discovery from the inference list, the OpenCode catalog and the console docs.
description.zh: opencode.ai/inference 免费档模型。请求携带与 OpenCode 1.19.0 完全一致的头部（免费档会 403 其他请求），并从推理列表、OpenCode 目录与控制台文档动态发现模型。

description.en: Each created account receives a distinct, isolated project and session identity. You may enter any custom label (e.g. account nickname) or leave it as public.
description.zh: 每次创建的账号都会自动分配全新的独立设备与项目会话身份，实现完全隔离。可填入任意自定义身份别名或填 public。

label.zh: 身份别名 / 凭据（如 public、dev-1）
